data: For the fiscal year ended June 30, 2024, Microsoft reported revenue of $245,122 million (about $245.1 billion) and net income of $88,136 million (about $88.1 billion), according to its fiscal 2024 Form 10-K filed July 30, 2024. Revenue rose from $211,915 million in fiscal 2023, an increase of $33,207 million or about 15.7%. Net income grew from $72,361 million in fiscal 2023, an increase of roughly 21.8%, and diluted earnings per share rose from $9.68 to $11.80. Part of the fiscal 2024 revenue came from the Activision Blizzard acquisition, which contributed $5,729 million of revenue and an operating loss of $1,362 million.
